name: ots-desk
prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot. The person lowers their hand from their chin to the keyboard and types a few words, then nods slightly while reading. The laptop screen content stays still, sharp and unchanged. Very slow push-in toward the screen, morning light, realistic, no text overlays.

name: ots-kitchen
prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot in a warm kitchen. The person stirs the mushrooms in the pan with the wooden spoon, steam rises and the pan sizzles, then they lean toward the laptop to read the next step. The laptop screen content stays still, sharp and unchanged. Gentle handheld drift, realistic, no text overlays.

name: ots-cafe
prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot in a sunny cafe. The person reaches for the flat white, takes a sip while looking at the illustration on the laptop screen, and sets the cup down. Background patrons move softly. The laptop screen content stays still, sharp and unchanged. Slow lateral slide, realistic, no text overlays.
